# Magic Mirror

> GNOME Shell extension that adds a switch to the top bar. One click toggles
> between a saved multi-monitor layout and the laptop's built-in display only.

Useful for people who often plug a laptop into external monitors (a dock, a
desk setup, a monitor shared with another computer) and are tired of fixing
the display layout in GNOME Settings every time. It targets GNOME Shell 46
(e.g. Ubuntu 24.04) and ships as a Debian package.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/zniszcz/magic-mirror/blob/main/README.md): usage, install, uninstall, logs
- [Latest release](https://github.com/zniszcz/magic-mirror/releases/latest): the .deb package
